sources.concentratedPatch: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.5 (p. 533): on 300 mm x 300 mm unless the table says otherwise, not with the uniform load
sources.roofLive: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.8, Table 6.2.4 and its note (1) (p. 539): the greater of this and the rain load (Sec 2.6.2) is the roof live load; the concentrated load on 300 mm x 300 mm, not with the distributed load, not needed on roofs that spread it (RC slabs)
sources.partitions: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.6 (p. 538): light partitions (up to 5.5 kN per metre run) not on the plans: a uniform live load of at least 33 % of the weight per metre run, and at least 1.2 kN/m2
sources.vehicles: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.5 (p. 533): loads 1.5 m apart, each 40 % of the heaviest vehicle, on 750 mm x 750 mm; private vehicles: 9 kN wheel loads; Table 6.2.3 note b (p. 537): 13.35 kN on a 114 mm x 114 mm jack footprint; mechanical parking without a slab: 10 kN per wheel
sources.barriers: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.11, Table 6.2.5 and its notes (pp. 540-541): handrail loads horizontal or vertical, not together; vehicle barrier forces horizontal over any 1.5 m at bumper height (375 mm for light vehicles); ramps 50 % at 610 mm; straight exit ramps over 20 m long twice
sources.impact: BNBC 2020 Part 6 Sec 2.3.12, Table 6.2.6 rows 1-4 (p. 541): additional load as a share of the static load including self-weight, increased if the manufacturer recommends (note 1); row 5, cranes, is in cranes.json
